turns.speaker: PRO

turns.text: If a negotiated agreement guarantees residency, family connection, and compensation, keeping a full return right protects those families from being erased. Under that condition, the right strengthens bargaining rather than blocking peace.

turns.speaker: PRO
turns.text: People also worry about deeds, inheritance, and who tends a neglected home, which are painful questions. But those details show why a final settlement must replace the full return claim with workable guarantees.

turns.speaker: CON
turns.text: Rights should not be discarded merely because implementation is hard. A lasting settlement must respect displaced families' claim to return, even when its practical form is negotiated over time.
